name: Carina Verritti
original_name: カリーナ・ベルリッティ
source: Princess of Ert'Aria, called "the Jewel of Ert'Aria", and Master of the Clan "Oasis". Childhood friends with Leicester and one of the very few (maybe the only one) magicians in the world. Usually a talented and elegant lady, when with Leicester delusions may get the best of her. Used to have a very frail health, but she got more healthy after starting to use magic.
